programs.description: When Shekhar falls for Roopa, he approaches her father with his parents. However, when his stepmother asks Roopa's father for dowry, he vows to marry his daughter elsewhere.
Falsely accused of robbery and sent to prison for 12 years, a bank manager realises upon his return that a person whom he trusted had betrayed him.
Two brothers who excel in boxing are separated in childhood and take different paths after their father, a police officer, is murdered by a gangster.
Shashikant and Gauri get married in honour of his late father's will. But, marital problems soon arise when Gauri suspects him of having an affair, leading to a chain of misunderstandings.

programs.showName: Love Ke Liye Kuch Bhi Karega
programs.description: Prakash plans to extort money from his distrusting father-in-law. Rahul and Harry, who are in desperate need of cash, join hands with Prakash and help kidnap his wife as part of the plan.
Deepa, a young woman, meets Sanjay and falls in love with him. But when she goes to Bombay to look for a job, the arrival of a former lover puts her in a quandary.
When Amba gets her son Rajendra arrested for sexually assaulting their servant's daughter, Rajendra's wife wreaks havoc in their lives as she vows to avenge him.
A flood separates childhood friends Seema and Rajesh. Years later, when she reconciles with him and the two plan to get together, things go awry with the arrival of a mysterious woman.
Three men are accused of stealing a crown and whilst on the run, they are transported to the 10th century. Amidst several adventures, they must try to bring the crown back to prove their innocence.
Ajay and Pooja fall in love and decide to get married. To earn money and get settled, Ajay applies for a job in Bombay, but is framed in a rape case and is imprisoned for four years.

Dev, Vishal and Hrithik enter a singing competition. However, life is complicated for them as they face numerous obstacles in their personal lives which slowly bring out the best in them.
Kallu's life changes after his brother, Shamu, meets with an accident and requires money for his treatment. As a result, he is forced to rob Shamu's employer but gets arrested instead.
When Asha is unable to conceive and loses her eyesight, her mother-in-law throws her out of the house and arranges for her son to remarry.
When an ordinary man discovers crores in his account, he is thrown into a tangled mess of crime, impersonation and corrupt connections he never asked for.
After his stepfather is murdered, Sahil gets arrested, but he manages to escape prison to prove his innocence. However, Inspector Udham Singh sets off to capture him.
A wife embraces her husband's illegitimate son as her own in honour of the other woman's memory. However, as time progresses, this starts to seem like a big mistake.
Durga marries Prakash, unaware of his mother Bhawani Devi's dominating and abusive nature. She later insists on moving in with his family in order to teach Bhawani Devi a lesson.
Anishka, the daughter of a doctor, is kidnapped, and the abductors demand a hefty ransom. When Dr Viren abides by their rules and delivers the money, the kidnappers vanish with the money and Anishka.
Dev and Priya fall in love despite being engaged to their respective partners and decide to reunite after six months to get married. However, destiny has other plans for them.
A policeman sacrifices his life protecting Savitri and her twins from a gangster. Savitri raises the fallen officer's son as her twins, now separated, grow into a lawyer and a sniper.

Indian and Pakistani armies clash verbally, leading to a cricket match challenge where territorial pride hangs in the balance.
Fueled by a deep desire for revenge, two young boys mature into strong-minded adults and set out to secure the justice denied to their father years ago.
Mohanlal, a musician and a thief, robs rich people and distributes the money amongst the poor. However, things take a turn when he falls for Sunita, a wealthy man's daughter.
Destiny separates two lovers, Inder and Rama, and Inder marries Kamala. However, events take an unprecedented turn when Inder and Rama cross paths again years later.
Raju and Urmila fall deeply in love and vow to reunite in India. However, complications arise when Raju agrees to pose as Sharmila's husband before her family.
Ashok, a fraudster, pretends to be rich and cheats several people. However, things take a turn when he falls in love with Seema.
Gangaram brings up his stepbrothers and borrows money to educate them. But, when he fails to repay and faces legal trouble, his brothers strive to help him.
Geeta and her father undergo several hardships to ensure that Prakash gets an education abroad. However, things take a turn when, upon his return, he marries a rich girl.
Stepbrothers Aftab and Jai, who loathe each other, must learn to put aside their differences and work together to prove their innocence in a terrorism case.
Satpal Chauhan, a social worker from Haryana, works for women empowerment and also strives to create an alcohol-free society. However, while pursuing his goals, he faces several hardships.

A jailer's daughter falls for a prisoner poet, believing him wrongly convicted and strives to prove his innocence and secure his release.
Som's mother sees her son's selection for a singing reality show as a second chance to fulfil her own dreams. However, complications arise when he faces a quick defeat.
On a mission to stop a gang from circulating fake currency, Inspector Dinesh must adopt various disguises. As he chases the culprits, Dinesh unveils a dark secret.
When Prakash's father dies, he is forced to shoulder the financial responsibilities of his large family. However, his troubles increase when his younger brother leaves him home to join a gang.
Raja, a taxi driver, falls in love with Aarti, a rich girl and marries her against her parents' wishes. Later, her stepmother tries to create differences between the couple.
Things turn awry when a businessman, unaware of the truth, allows his pampered daughter to get engaged to the son of his old rival.
Suspecting an extra-marital affair, Vijay, a professor, abandons his wife, Laxmi. However, years later, when he is hurtled back into Laxmi's life through her adopted daughter, things become clearer.
Roopa asks Anoop to pretend to be her boyfriend so that people will not make fun of her for writing love letters to herself. However, Anoop develops feelings for her in the process.
Raj, an aspiring singer, rescues Pooja, the daughter of a wealthy man, from an accident. However, he soon finds himself in a web of complications when he falls in love with her best friend.
Bhushan, a tax inspector, meets Ajit, a businessman evading an IT raid, on a cruise ship. In a bizarre turn of events, Ajit and Bhushan get lost on an isolated island.

Arjun, a youngster, works at a hotel owned by Raja and serves him faithfully. However, when he learns about a plot to kill Raja, he decides to save him from harm at any cost.
Twin brothers separated at birth become best friends, unaware of their bond as siblings. The queen, their mother, becomes the uniting force as they set out to defeat their evil uncle.
Babu, who kills a man, is blackmailed by Bhagat into assuming the identity of a wealthy heir, Kundan, for his money. However, things get complicated when Babu falls in love with Kundan's sister.

Amar sets out to avenge his father's death but gets beaten to the brink of death. He returns to carry on his vendetta, only to be confronted by Vicky, a criminal-turned-policeman and his close friend.
Rahul looks after his spoilt nephews, Sunny and Vicky, and niece, Munni. When they go to a funfair, they meet Vyjayanti, who has run away from home, and decide to shelter her without Rahul's consent.

Rukhsar asks her best friend Nagma to marry her husband, Aslam, and mother a child for him when she is unable to do it herself. However, problems begin when Nagma's relatives cause discord among them.
The police are out on the hunt for a serial killer who targets beautiful women. Their luck changes when a woman who is in love with one of the suspects joins the search.
Two brothers struggle to keep their family together as external forces like the younger brother's father-in-law try to break them apart.
Twin brothers Raja and Prem Malhotra get separated at birth but are reunited by fate to defeat Ratanlal, a local gangster, who wants to destroy the Malhotra family.

Police Inspector Kapil Khanna realises that his baby boy has been switched with a girl child by the hospital and files a lawsuit against the owner, Robert Decosta, while trying to find his missing son.

Twins Amit and Kishan are separated at birth. However, when their paths cross in the future, together they work their way through and strive to overcome challenges.
After losing his job owing to his arrogance and subsequently his son, Vijay, Atmaram realises his mistake and decides to turn over a new leaf.
Shyam, a middle-class man, falls in love with a millionaire's daughter and marries her. However, as their relationship starts deteriorating, Shyam finds solace in the company of Radha.
Believing his wife to be dead, Anand gives up his own child to Yashoda, who has lost her husband and her baby. However, he faces a dilemma when his wife returns.
Vijay and Ajay make a living by stealing money from people. Their friendship is affected when Vijay discovers that Ajay's father may have been his father's killer.
After his lookalike, Ranjith, convinces Bhola to impersonate him for money, an innocent Bhola soon finds himself in trouble when the police chase after him for Ranjith's crimes.
Talented sisters, Sita and Lata, are renowned performing artists. However, the rivalry between them leads to a competition with far-reaching consequences.
Veeru and Dheeru live under the tyrant ruler, Raja Jaichand. Later, they embark on a mission and strive to overcome challenges to defeat the dictator.
Three brothers, each raised in different religious households, reunite after many years in a chance encounter. They set out to take revenge on those responsible for separating them.
A wife embraces her husband's illegitimate son as her own in honour of the other woman's memory. However, as time progresses, this starts to seem like a big mistake.

A man falls victim to a tragic twist of fate, enduring an imprisonment and bearing the weight of his consequences for the rest of his life.
A casino owner is trapped by a gangster and forced to work for him. However, when he refuses to kill a commissioner, the gangster abducts his secretary and sister to blackmail him.
Anand, a rich youngster, denounces his wealth to establish himself independently. However, he keeps struggling in the big city until Renu, a middle-class woman, helps him, and he falls for her.
A poet falls in love with a girl and later realises that she is terminally ill. Despite being aware of her condition, he decides to marry her and keep her happy.
After a journalist helps to release him from prison, a man agrees to work as a hitman for her, leading him to entangle with a battle between two drug lords.
Ajay, a businessman, provides funds to Sarjuprasad to develop his hometown. When he learns that the money has been misappropriated by Sarjuprasad, he resolves to set things right.
When Amba Prasad realises the harsh truth that his relatives just care for his money, he leaves home. Upon reaching a village, he meets Arun and Aarti and his life changes forever.
Kishan, a dairy farmer, and Kabir, his brother, run into trouble when a local promoter decides to take over their land. When a corrupt inspector plays his part and kills Kabir, Kishan vows vengeance.
Raju and Madhu are forced apart by the latter's elder brothers, leading to increased distance between the two.
Born out of wedlock, Vijay grows up with deep resentment towards his biological father Raj, a wealthy industrialist who has been leading a comfortable life with his legitimate family in the big city.
